reports.title: CAVA GROUP REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS

guidance.heading: Fiscal Full-Year 2026 Outlook
section: CAVA Group announced today that it updated fiscal full-year 2026 guidance, as follows:

August 11, 2026 | November 4, 2026
Net New CAVA Restaurant Openings | 75 to 77 | 76 to 78
Same Restaurant Sales | 4.5% to 6.5% | 6.0% to 7.0%
CAVA Restaurant-Level Profit Margin | 23.7% to 24.3% | 23.7% to 24.0%
Pre-opening costs | $22.0 to $22.5 million | $28.5 to $29.5 million
Adjusted EBITDA | $181.0 to $191.0 million | $184.0 to $189.0 million
control, or cannot be reasonably predicted. For these reasons, we are unable to assess the potential significance of the unavailable information.
